elements.name: Admin Login with valid credentials
User search for an existing course using the exact course name

steps.name: the admin is on the WaveInit login page

match.name: user is on the LMS application
the admin selects the Admin Login option
the admin enters valid admin credentials
the admin clicks the Login button
the admin should be logged in successfully
the user login with valid credentials
the user navigate to the My Courses page
the user enter the existing course name in the search field
the admin should be redirected to the Admin Dashboard
the user search for the course
the matching course should be displayed in the course list

User search for a course that does not exist
user is on the LMS application
the user login with valid credentials
the user navigate to the My Courses page
the user enter a non-existing course name in the search field
the user should see "No courses found matching your criteria" message
User clear the course search field
user is on the LMS application
the user login with valid credentials
the user navigate to the My Courses page
the user enter a course name in the search field
the matching course should be displayed
the user clear the search field
the search field should be empty
all available courses should be displayed
